# Instructions for generating artwork
## Style Rules
- Artistic style is cartoon.
- Drawings should be more like Josh Kirby than Manga.
- All portraits should be the same size.
- All images should be in PNG format.
- All images should have a transparent background.
- Classes
  - Witch
  - Wizard
  - Warrior
- Genders
  - Male
  - Female
- Ages
  - Young
  - Old
- Witch artefacts
  - none
  - a wand
  - a crystal ball
  - a cat familiar
  - a broomstick
- Wizard artefacts
  - none
  - a staff
  - a spell book
  - a raven familiar
  - a skull
- Warrior artefacts
  - none
  - a two handed sword
  - a longbow
  - a spear
  - a sword and shield
- Locations
  - Cave
  - Castle
  - Cottage
  - Crypt
  - Caravan

- Each class can be any gender.
- Each class can be any age.
- Each class can be at any location.
- Each class can carry at most one artefact, appropriate to that class.

- Witches wear black and have pointed hats. 
- Wizards wear coloured robes and have pointed hats.
- Warriors wear light armour.

## Subjects:
- Generate images for each class * gender * age called a character (12)
- Each character should be generated as a headshot and as five full body images
- Each full body image should be drawn with an appropriate artefact for that class in front of each location (60)
- The five full body images for each character should use a different artefact and a different location.

## Intended Use:
- The images will be used as online games assets.

## Technical Preferences:
- Use DALL-E 3 for best rule following and transparent backgrounds
- Alternative: Midjourney with --v 6 for Josh Kirby style consistency
